extraction.Name: Bose Elizabeth Larvine
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 2, 1918 by Richard Jones
extraction.Buyer: Bose Elizabeth Larvine Breast and William Breast conveyed the land by deed to Paul H. Putnam for $1100
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612471 issued; Northeast quarter section 10, township 40, north of range 33; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee March 1, 1918; conveyance dated March 12, 1918; grantee also listed as William Breast (possibly husband)
